root_cause.text: Using 32-bit integer types (`unsigned int`) to hold DMA addresses in `__rdma_block_iter_next()` causes integer overflow when reassembling large blocks (>= 4GiB) from split SG entries, resulting in incorrect DMA address computation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the types of `block_offset` and `delta` from `unsigned int` to `dma_addr_t`, and the commit message and CVE description explicitly state that 32-bit stack values overflow when block sizes are >= 4G.
